name: gajuuzz_stgcn
description: Skeleton-based fall detection (graph convolutional family). Tiny-YOLOv3 one-class person detection -> SPPE FastPose (AlphaPose) 2D skeleton -> SORT-style tracker with a 30-frame buffer -> ST-GCN (TSSTG) 7-class action recognition. A frame is a fall when a confirmed track's action == 'Fall Down'. Fills the GCN architecture family that the literature review covers but no other detector represents.

model_info.architecture: TinyYOLOv3-onecls (person) + SPPE FastPose ResNet50 (AlphaPose skeleton) + ST-GCN / TSSTG (7-class action recognition)
model_info.training_dataset: COCO (pose backbone); ST-GCN action model trained on Le2i + custom 7-action skeleton set

frame_skip.description: Process every Nth frame (1 = every frame). Note: ST-GCN needs 30 consecutive processed frames per track before it can classify.

inp_dets.description: Tiny-YOLO input resolution for person detection

gpu_support.notes: Three stacked models (Tiny-YOLO + FastPose ResNet50 + ST-GCN) per frame. GPU strongly recommended; CPU works but is slow (expect minutes per clip).
